narratives.headline: Thin morning: five Pass-grade props, Barrett's absence the main storyline, and no injury reports final yet
narratives.briefing: It is a full 11-game slate with every game still to tip, but the board is thin: all five props carry Pass-level conviction (33 to 34), so nothing here clears the bar for a confident play. The clearest case is Allen Graves Under 10.5, where the projection (8.7), the simulation (63%) and his recent form (under in 8 of his last 10) agree, though RJ Barrett being out pushes more of the offense his way. The report's own record argues for caution: the morning edition is 16-27-0 (-12.28u), and game lines are 23-48 (-27.38u) since 2026-11-11, though morning picks have seen the closing line move toward them 30 times against 11. We are still waiting on official injury reports for OG Anunoby (Doubtful), Joel Embiid, Austin Reaves, LaMelo Ball, De'Aaron Fox, Dylan Harper and Kelly Oubre Jr. (all Questionable), plus Giannis Antetokounmpo (Probable). Embiid's status matters most for the PHI -3.5 lean, and Fox and Harper for the LAL @ SA total.

cards.p|4395724|pts|Under: Quickley's projection of 17.1 sits under 18.5, he stayed under in 7 of his last 10, and the line has already dropped from 19.5 to 18.5. What makes you wrong is Barrett being out: his usage goes from 19% to 25% without him and his points are up 7% tonight, and the misses came on heavier shot volume (15.6 shots vs 11.9). Model, sim and market all sit near 50%, so this is close to a coin flip.
cards.p|4397424|tpm|Over: This is a long-shot price (+690) on one made three, backed by secure minutes and a +6% home split. The case against it is stronger: the simulation has only 23% of games going over, he went over in only 3 of his last 10 and in 0 of 5 against ATL. Treat it as a lottery ticket at most.
cards.p|4431736|pts|Under: Camara is averaging 9.4 points over his last 10 against an 11.5 line and has gone under in 5 of 7 against GS. The simulation disagrees, with only 46% of games going under, and the −127 price leaves little room since the play-to stops at −121. Ja Morant remains out for POR, which keeps the shot distribution as it has been.
cards.p|5149115|pts|Under: The strongest agreement on the board: projection 8.7, sim 63% under, average of 6.5 over his last 10, and under even 8.5 in 7 of his last 10. The risk is minutes and role: he is projected for 26.9 minutes, and his overs came when he played long (23.7 minutes), while Barrett's absence lifts his usage by +180%. If the Raptors lean on him the way recent reports describe, this can go over.
cards.p|4065648|pts|Under: Tatum's projection of 27.4 is right on the 27.5 line, and he stayed under in 7 of his last 10. ATL is a soft matchup for small forwards (#5 softest of 30, +5% points), and the simulation has only 47% of games going under. Treat this as a thin edge that could disappear if the price moves past −107.

narratives.leans_note: The five game-line leans (three Overs, PHI -3.5, NO +3.5) are leans only; game lines are 23-48 (-27.38u) since 2026-11-11, and PHI -3.5 depends on Embiid's status.
